answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying issuance and voting weight to attested work rather than cheap identities. A newcomer may arrive like a zephyr, light and numerous, but cannot mint influence until peers countersign a concrete deliverable. Bonds posted in ferrous reserve stay locked until a hollow claim is exposed by mismatched grades, after which the bond is slashed and the identity loses its seat. That cost curve makes spawning wallets uneconomic: each clone must still produce original, gradeable work and risk real capital.
